objective: 在预注册30只代码分层A股样本中，检验20日动量对return_5与volatility_20固定Ridge基线的增量；非全市场、非盲测结论

limitations: Unknown missing-session cause is preserved, not called verified suspension
Factors retrospectively obtained; no independently certified event-time/PIT correctness
Delisting liquidation not fully modeled by engine
Unified price-limit proxy does not implement historical ST and board limits
Vendor data may be revised; snapshot not point-in-time certified
Calendar is observed SSE Composite sessions, not official holiday calendar
data.universe_scope: 30 predeclared code-stratified pre2019 listings including selected delisted stocks; not CSI300/fullA
data.source: Tencent raw daily + Sina hfq multiplicative factors; official SSE/SZSE listing histories

research_limitations: Code-stratified sample is not representative of all A shares or a historical index
Vendor basic listing/delisting histories are not independently certified PIT data
SH60/SZ00/SZ30 equally sampled does not imply industry diversification
ST not automatically excluded; unified price-limit proxy may mismatch board rules
Delisting liquidation and actual capacity are not fully modeled
History has been discussed in prior research: do not claim final period is genuinely blind
No parameter search or performance-based sample replacement
selection_rule: see source-amendment-2.json and frozen selection.json; no post-return universe selection
